integrity: Proof, exact formal coefficient identity, extremal Stirling-number formula and reproducibility script supplied. Finite checks are reported with exact scopes; no independent external audit or comprehensive priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple rook graphs only; no extension to other forcing rules or general Cartesian products. The counting theorem rests on proof; finite enumeration is corroborative. Relevant 2020 and 2024 publications could not be read in full, so originality has residual literature risk.
title: Zero-forcing polynomials of rook graphs via bipartite forests
